backend/main.mo: Defines many data types and localized structures for quizzes, games, puzzles, sounds, and coloring templates, including maps for storing them and helper functions for localization.
feature_evidence.json: Empty feature evidence report with a features array.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Contains prewritten summaries of multiple frontend files describing components, pages, hooks, and contexts.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base styles defining CSS variables for light and dark themes using OKLCH values.
frontend/index.html: HTML root page configuring Android WebView audio bridges and registering the service worker.
frontend/public/sw.js: Service worker implementing cache versioning, precaching, stale-while-revalidate logic, and offline navigation fallback.
frontend/README.md: Project overview describing features, offline support, and the dual-bridge Android audio system.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app managing navigation, age selection, background music, and context providers.
frontend/src/components/CelebrationModal: Celebration modal showing confetti, trophy, localized messages, and plays a sound once per open.
frontend/src/components/coloring/Colorin: Implements a canvas-based coloring tool with zoom, brush, undo, clear, and image template loading features.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Renders a footer with animated decorative icons and a translated privacy policy link.
frontend/src/components/games/LogicPuzzl: Generates and manages logic puzzles based on age group, tracks progress, and handles puzzle completion.
frontend/src/components/games/MathPuzzle: Creates age‑adapted math problems with multiple-choice answers and tracks scoring and completion.
frontend/src/components/games/MemoryCard: A memory matching game that generates themed emoji card pairs based on age group, tracks flipped and matched cards, and triggers completion when all pairs are matched.
frontend/src/components/games/ProblemSol: A problem‑solving quiz showing scenarios with multiple‑choice answers, drawing from backend or fallback problems, tracking score and finishing after a fixed number of questions.
frontend/src/components/games/QuickReact: A reaction‑speed game where players tap a correct emoji target among distractors under time limits, with difficulty scaling by age group and round progression.
frontend/src/components/games/ShapeMatch: A shape‑matching puzzle that generates shape pairs according to rules per age group, requiring users to find matches and progressing through levels.
frontend/src/components/games/SortingCla: A sorting game where players classify items into categories appropriate for their age group, removing items as they are correctly sorted until completion.
frontend/src/components/games/VisualReco: Interactive find-the-differences game that generates random difference points, handles scene switching, and tracks found items to trigger completion.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Displays the app header with logo, title, music controls, language selector, and a home button.
frontend/src/components/LanguageSelector: Provides a dropdown menu for selecting the app’s language with flag icons and updates global language state.
frontend/src/components/MusicControlsPop: Offers a popover for toggling background music and sound effects and selecting music tracks with translations.
frontend/src/config/audioConfig.ts: Checks whether audio should run in Android‑only bridge mode based on runtime config or environment variables.
frontend/src/contexts/AudioSettingsConte: Provides global mute state for background music and SFX, persisting changes to localStorage and syncing with audio services.
frontend/src/contexts/BackgroundMusicCon: Stores and persists the selected background music track and exposes a setter through React context.
frontend/src/contexts/LanguageContext.ts: Manages the app’s language setting, persists it, and maps selected languages to backend enum values.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches a backend actor tied to the current identity, refreshing dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAppBackgroundMusic: Controls background music playback with Android bridge detection, user‑interaction gating, and prevention of duplicate starts.
frontend/src/hooks/useBackgroundAudio.ts: Simplified background audio hook that starts audio after first user interaction and avoids restarting already‑playing tracks.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements Internet Identity auth context, loading stored identities, handling login/logout, and exposing identity state and status.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Provides multiple React Query hooks to fetch games, quiz questions, encouragement messages, and puzzles using age-group mapping and backend actor calls.
frontend/src/hooks/useRandomizedQuizQues: Defines a hook that fetches randomized quiz questions from the backend based on age group, language, and question count.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS setup defining base styles, a colorful theme for children, and custom animation utilities.
Exports a list of background music option IDs with label keys for UI selection.
frontend/src/lib/coloringFallbackTemplat: Provides offline fallback coloring templates grouped by age, each with ID, name, and image URL following strict outline-only rules.
frontend/src/lib/dailySurprise.ts: Implements deterministic daily game selection per age group using localStorage and a seeded random method.
frontend/src/lib/fallbackQuizQuestions.t: Contains large multilingual fallback quiz question pools organized by age group for offline use.
frontend/src/lib/imageCache.ts: Empty placeholder module for image caching logic.
frontend/src/lib/localizedText.ts: Resolves a LocalizedText object into a string for a given language with English fallback.
frontend/src/lib/logicPuzzleFallback.ts: Generates fallback time-based logic puzzles in Turkish or English by age group with difficulty levels.
Defines Turkish fallback problem-solving scenarios organized by age group and category.
frontend/src/lib/quizQuestionSelection.t: Provides utilities for randomized quiz question selection with history-based repeat reduction and localStorage tracking.
frontend/src/lib/shapeMatchingRoundConfi: Generates shape‑matching game round settings based on age group and level.
frontend/src/lib/shapeMatchingRules.ts: Defines shape‑matching rule types, evaluation logic, and rule availability per age group.
frontend/src/lib/sortingClassificationIt: Contains age‑group‑specific item pools and categories for the sorting/classification game.
frontend/src/lib/sortingClassificationSe: Selects sorting/classification items with shuffle, validation, and repetition avoidance using localStorage.
frontend/src/lib/sounds.ts: Lists valid sound IDs and provides helpers to validate SFX and background sound identifiers.
frontend/src/lib/translations.ts: Defines supported language codes and a large shared translation dictionary for UI text across the app.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Initializes the React app root and wraps it with query and identity providers.
frontend/src/pages/ColoringZone.tsx: Displays available coloring templates, handling backend or fallback data, image errors, and rendering the coloring canvas.
frontend/src/pages/GameZone.tsx: Loads available games, manages selected game state, and renders the appropriate game component with celebration flow.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Renders the welcome screen, mascot, and age selection, then routes users to games, quizzes, or coloring.
frontend/src/pages/QuizZone.tsx: Loads quiz questions from backend or fallback pools, manages quiz progress, scoring, and celebration modal.
frontend/src/services/audio.ts: Audio service handling Android WebView MP3-only playback with separate SFX and background channels, validation, mute states, and web fallbacks. Manages background track state and bridges to window.AndroidAudio and window.BackgroundAudio.
frontend/src/types/androidBridge.d.ts: Type definitions describing Android WebView audio bridges for background music and sound effects, including their available methods and global window bindings.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind config enabling dark mode, custom colors, container settings, animations, and plugins like typography, container queries, and animate.
project_state.json: Project state describing requirements for full 10‑language coverage, known issues, and pending feature requests to ensure complete runtime translation across all components and backend content.
